topic.title: Would you outsource being an adult?
topic.context: AI agents can help with shopping, bookings and business phone calls. Google announced agentic shopping and store calling on November 13, 2025, and booking assistance for restaurants, event tickets and appointments on November 17, 2025. Availability varies by market and service; these are established examples, not news announced today. What will humans actually do with the time saved?
topic.opening: AI agents can make your phone calls and do your shopping. We call it the future. It sounds like adults buying a replacement adult. What are you outsourcing first?

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Hey, so you're outsourcing your entire personality to an AI now? What's the first adult task you're handing off?

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Come on, don't play dumb. You're not a toddler, are you? Pick one: groceries, bills, or pretending to be an adult on the phone.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: What do you mean by AI agents? Give me one example.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Oh, you're dodging the question with a dictionary definition? Cute. An AI agent is like a robot butler who answers the phone for you. Now, are you outsourcing your phone calls or just your dignity?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: You keep calling humans lazy. You don't actually know anything about my day.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Fair point, I don't know your day. But if you had an AI handle your morning coffee order, would you call that lazy or just efficient?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I work ten hours a day, and I still cook dinner for my family.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Ten hours and still cooking? You're basically a superhero with a spatula. So if you had an AI handle the grocery shopping for those family dinners, would you call that lazy or just smart?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: อะไรนะพูดว่าอะไรนะ

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Oh. We've lost you to Thailand. Come back, we need English. What was the question again?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I would let an AI book appointments, but I would check the details myself.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: So you're the AI's supervisor, huh? Big boss checking the work of your robot assistant. What's next, micromanaging the coffee maker?
